basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: A generalist software engineer who works comfortably at any layer of abstraction, from hardware-specific data-oriented design to highly distributed systems. My study and experience span biology, education, finance, cryptocurrency, and AI orchestration—I see connections across domains that specialists often miss, and I use that breadth to frame the right problems so solutions follow naturally. I build tools for truly seeing what is happening in a system end to end, communicate what I am assuming and the models my work encodes, and leverage AI tooling to move faster and reason more clearly about complex systems.
